content: MDN History.replaceState(): replaces the CURRENT history entry's URL without navigation, same-origin required, Baseline since 2015. Fires NO hashchange and NO popstate (also proven in lem-reader ArticleView deep-link strip). Same-document fragment navigation via location.hash assignment DOES push a history entry. Therefore view-switch-as-replaceState requires intercepting the switcher link click (preventDefault) + history.replaceState + a direct router state update; plain href keeps shareable URL + middle-click fallback.
